name: solarize-the-website-extension
description: Recolor white and gray backgrounds to Solarized Light, and dark ones to Solarized Dark, on any website.

scripts.build:chrome: TARGET=chrome vite build --mode development && TARGET=chrome BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode development && TARGET=chrome BUILD_TARGET=hook vite build --mode development && rm -f dist/solarize-chrome-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../solarize-chrome-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:firefox: TARGET=firefox vite build --mode development && TARGET=firefox BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode development && TARGET=firefox BUILD_TARGET=hook vite build --mode development && rm -f dist/solarize-firefox-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/firefox && zip -qr ../solarize-firefox-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:safari: TARGET=safari vite build --mode development && TARGET=safari BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode development && TARGET=safari BUILD_TARGET=hook vite build --mode development && rm -f dist/solarize-safari-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/safari && zip -qr ../solarize-safari-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build: tsc && pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox && pnpm run build:safari
scripts.build:chrome:release: TARGET=chrome vite build --mode production && TARGET=chrome BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode production && TARGET=chrome BUILD_TARGET=hook vite build --mode production && rm -f dist/solarize-chrome-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../solarize-chrome-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:firefox:release: TARGET=firefox vite build --mode production && TARGET=firefox BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode production && TARGET=firefox BUILD_TARGET=hook vite build --mode production && rm -f dist/solarize-firefox-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/firefox && zip -qr ../solarize-firefox-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:safari:release: TARGET=safari vite build --mode production && TARGET=safari BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode production && TARGET=safari BUILD_TARGET=hook vite build --mode production && rm -f dist/solarize-safari-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/safari && zip -qr ../solarize-safari-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:release: tsc && pnpm run build:chrome:release && pnpm run build:firefox:release && pnpm run build:safari:release
